description: This file contains the implementation of the Lexer class for Twig templating engine, responsible for tokenizing Twig template source code.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Implements tokenization of Twig templates, converting source code into a stream of tokens based on defined lexical rules.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Converts a Twig source object into a stream of tokens.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the lexer by compiling regex patterns and setting up initial state.

methods.name: lexData
methods.description: Lexes raw template data, determining whether to switch to comment, block, or variable lexing.

methods.name: lexBlock
methods.description: Lexes a block of Twig template code.

methods.name: lexVar
methods.description: Lexes a variable expression within the template.

methods.name: lexExpression
methods.description: Lexes expressions including operators, names, numbers, strings, and punctuation.

methods.name: lexRawData
methods.description: Lexes a raw data block, such as verbatim content.

methods.name: lexString
methods.description: Lexes string literals, including handling of interpolation.

methods.name: pushToken
methods.description: Adds a token to the token stream.

methods.name: moveCursor
methods.description: Advances the cursor position based on the consumed text.

methods.name: getOperatorRegex
methods.description: Generates regex pattern for operators based on environment operators.

methods.name: pushState
methods.description: Pushes current state onto stack and sets new state.
